CustomField.description: Origin of a model command input that appears in the transcript as its own turn: a human response, operator guidance, or engine feedback on a rejected model response. Blank means the input is already represented by another turn, such as the run input or a tool result.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Read-only execution evidence. Shows who supplied this turn's input: a person's reply, an operator's guidance, or Core's feedback on a rejected model response.
CustomField.label: Input Source
